newsitem.title: UK: Canada Maritime puts 1,000-teu ship on Med route.
newsitem.headline: Canada Maritime puts 1,000-teu ship on Med route.

text.p: Canada Maritime said on Tuesday it has deployed the 1,000-teu container ship Canmar Valour to replace two existing vessels on route B of its North America to Mediterranean service.

The 1979-built ship, recently acquired from Orient Overseas Container Line, was compatible with other Canmar ships on the route and would strengthen the service's schedule relaibility, the company said. It would replace the Canmar Spirit and Canmar Venture.
The Canmar Valour would enter drydock in October for an overhaul which would include new radar equipment and paint protection from the effects of sailing through ice.

Canada Maritime is part of CP Ships, the container shipping interest of Canadian Pacific Ltd, which is in the process of acquiring U.S. container shipping line Lykes Bros Steamship Co for $34 million.
